title: Sameer Business Park
priceDisplay: From KES 80 per sq. ft. per month
description:
Sameer Business Park is a modern transformative experience of corporate offices cum showrooms complex set on 8.8 acres along Mombasa Road, Nairobi. It is accessible from both Mombasa Road and Enterprise Road.

Designed for maximum flexibility, it has five blocks with well-finished lobbies and public spaces, separate entrances for office and showroom space, a coffee lounge and restaurant, a food court, ample surface and underground secured parking and separate loading bays.

All units have private washrooms, tea rooms and high-speed lifts. The flexible internal layout will suit any occupier including top-end retail showrooms, offices, BPO and Call Centres with multiple fibre optic connection options.

title: The Mandrake
priceDisplay: USD 1.30 per sq. ft. per month
description:
This is a landmark Grade-A office building in Westlands situated at Vale Close, off Ring Road Parklands; it comprises 11 floors of office spaces and 5 floors of parking.

This is a Green Building that has won several awards, including Best Office Development 2024–2025 by African Property Awards Development.

It provides a thriving community for trailblazers that nurtures creativity, collaboration, and success. With accessible green spaces for occupants to use, it ensures a sense of wellness and holistic design to propel a new era of inspired work.

title: Rivaan Centre
priceDisplay: KES 110 per sq. ft. per month
description:
A modern office building situated at a convenient location in Westlands, Muguga Green/Brookside area.

The 6-storey building offers high-quality office accommodation designed to international standards to offer occupiers a secure, highly efficient and flexible working environment.

title: 874 James Gichuru
priceDisplay: From USD 1.20 per sq. ft. per month
description:
874 is a contemporary commercial address designed for forward-thinking businesses.

Located along James Gichuru Road, it combines bold architecture with purposeful design to create an environment that reflects ambition and excellence. Every line, surface, and material has been considered to support productivity while maintaining a quiet sense of distinction, a place where work, design, and identity align.

Each space supports efficiency, comfort, and sophistication, creating an environment where performance and design coexist seamlessly. Managed with professionalism and attention to detail, 874 redefines what it means to work in excellence.

title: Parklands Office Suites
priceDisplay: KES 90 per sq. ft. per month
description: Office building situated along Parklands Road near the University of Nairobi School of Law.

title: Elgon Place
priceDisplay: KES 110 per sq. ft. per month
description:
This is a well-positioned office building located in the heart of Upper Hill, one of Nairobi’s most established districts associated with financial and insurance headquarters, as well as medical services. It was designed to support modern office setups, offering a professional environment ideal for corporates, NGOs, consultancies, medical practitioners, and growing enterprises seeking a strategic address.

The property is very accessible from several directions, including CBD, Mombasa Road, Langata Road, Ngong Road and Milimani, thereby allowing convenient connections and proximity to key institutions, hotels, financial hubs, and government offices.

Elgon Place combines architectural functionalism with modern workspace design. Spanning 7 floors, it offers open-plan floor plates designed for versatile space planning, whether tailored for individual private offices, high-density corporate team spaces, or vibrant executive suites.

title: Peponi Plaza
priceDisplay: KES 100 per sq. ft. per month
description: This is a well-established office building in the Peponi/Westgate area of Westlands, situated along Mwanzi Road.

title: The Riverfront
priceDisplay: KES 100 per sq. ft. per month
description:
This is a premier office development strategically located off Riverside Drive near the Chiromo Road junction. Combining serene, green surroundings with rapid connectivity to Westlands and the Nairobi CBD, The Riverfront offers high-grade corporate workspaces designed for multinationals, tech leaders, financial institutions, and established professional firms.

It offers open-plan floor plates designed for versatile space planning that are easily customizable for executive suites, partitioned private offices, boardrooms, or expansive collaborative layouts.

title: Fidelity Insurance Centre
priceDisplay: KES 100 per sq. ft. per month
description:
Fidelity Insurance Centre is a prominent commercial office building situated along Waiyaki Way in Westlands, Nairobi’s premier commercial and business hub. It is in the Waiyaki Way/Safaricom House area.

Positioned to offer maximum corporate visibility along one of the city's major transport arteries, the building provides functional, highly accessible office spaces tailored for financial services, legal firms, logistics headquarters, and growing corporate enterprises.

title: Union Place
priceDisplay: USD 1 per sq. ft. per month
description: Union Place is an executive logistics hub and commercial office facility situated along 1st Freight Lane, off Freight Road, in the Cargo Village of Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA). Designed to serve international freight forwarders, air cargo handlers, clearing agents, and supply chain operators, the property offers a high-security, highly accessible commercial workspace at East Africa's primary aviation gateway.

title: Lavington Court
priceDisplay: KES 100 per sq. ft. per month
description:
Situated at Muthangari Drive, this mixed-use property is offering retail space of 3,100 sq. ft. and a 4,300 sq. ft. terrace that is ideal for a restaurant or other suitable retail use.

It is in the Waiyaki Way/Safaricom House area.

title: 3-Star Hotel, Nairobi CBD
description:
A full-service 3-star commercial hotel asset available for sale as a going concern. It comprises 119 rooms, conference facilities, restaurant, bar and lounge, fitness centre, and a rooftop pool, all sited on a 0.36-acre plot.

This 6-storey hospitality property presents a turnkey investment opportunity combining immediate cash flow, strong corporate client retention, and substantial operational upside. The property offers seamless operational continuity, fully upgraded guest facilities, diverse food and beverage outlets, and extensive conference infrastructure.

It is on offer as a complete going concern (walk-in, walk-out) inclusive of all operational assets, inventory, and branding framework. More details, including photos, are available upon application.

title: The Riverside
description:
The Riverside is an exclusive 4-bedroom plus DSQ luxury apartment available for sale on Riverside Drive.

Positioned minutes away from Westlands, embassies, and international schools, this residence is ideal for executive homeowners and high-net-worth investors.

Features include expansive layouts, a fully fitted contemporary kitchen, a luxurious master suite with walk-in wardrobes and designer sanitaryware, supported by a rooftop swimming pool, fully equipped gym, high-speed elevators, backup generator, borehole water supply, access-controlled security, and reserved resident parking.

title: Grosvenor Residence
description:
Situated on Westlands Road near the GTC complex and Villa Rosa Kempinski, Grosvenor Residence offers elite urban living designed for corporate executives, high-yield investors, and discerning buyers seeking immediate proximity to Nairobi's prime commercial hub.

This property is steps away from GTC Mall, Sarit Centre, top dining destinations, and seamless access to the Nairobi Expressway via Waiyaki Way.

Features include sophisticated interiors with floor-to-ceiling windows, gourmet fully fitted kitchens, serene 1 and 2-bedroom suites supported by an advanced security framework, heated swimming pool, fully equipped fitness centre, residents' lounge, rooftop terrace, high-speed elevators, full backup power generator, and reliable borehole water supply.

title: Cheval Riverside
description:
This off-plan luxury apartment development is situated along Riverside Drive and is being developed by a reputable developer.

It is an iconic 20-storey residential development designed with yachting-inspired architecture and an expansive 65% open landscaped footprint. It offers high-end 1 and 2-bedroom residences with optional study layouts, tailored for corporate executives, diplomatic lets, and high-yield investors.

Features include floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, open-concept living and dining layouts and private balconies, supported by a rooftop wellness deck with a heated swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness centre, spa with massage suite, yoga studio, and panoramic skyline views. Lifestyle amenities include a co-working space, private cinema room, residents' lounge, games room, mini-market, high-speed and panoramic glass lifts, borehole water supply, full backup power, smart home integration, EV charging stations, and four basement levels of secure parking.

title: Rivera Tower
description:
Discover modern urban living at Rivera Tower, strategically designed for investors and home buyers seeking comfort, luxury, and convenience.

This is ideal as a prime residential home or a high-yield buy-to-let investment asset. Available units comprise two 3-bedroom and two 2-bedroom apartments.

Features include spacious layouts, modern kitchens, and master en-suite bedrooms supported by high-speed elevators, backup generator, borehole water supply, 24/7 security with CCTV surveillance, and dedicated parking.

title: Purple Haze
description:
Experience world-class living at Purple Haze, an award-winning development located on Kitale Lane, off Dennis Pritt Road in Kilimani. Designed by Singapore-based architects, this ultra-modern address combines high-end international finishes with unparalleled resort-style amenities.

Strategically situated minutes from Yaya Centre, Lavington, and the CBD, this property offers superior rental yield potential for investors and luxurious convenience for homeowners.

Features include a generous open-plan layout, a fully fitted Italian kitchen, en-suite bedrooms and DSQ supported by solar-heated swimming pools, a fully equipped TechnoGym fitness centre, steam and sauna facilities, rooftop gardens with party and koroga areas, residents' lounge, cigar room, library, on-site convenience store and restaurant, borehole water supply, solar water heating, full backup generator, high-speed elevators, two reserved parking slots, and 24/7 security with biometric access and CCTV.

title: Sohail Palms
description:
Positioned on Mvuli Road, just off Rhapta Road in the leafy, highly connected pocket of Westlands, Sohail Palms offers refined contemporary living designed for families and high-yield real estate investors alike.

It is minutes away from Sarit Centre, Westgate Mall, Artcaffè Market Rhapta Square, and key commercial hubs via Waiyaki Way.

Features include generous living spaces, a fully fitted kitchen, and en-suite bedrooms supported by high-speed lifts, borehole water supply, a full backup generator, high-speed fibre-optic internet readiness, and two dedicated parking slots per unit.

title: Crystal Court
description:
Crystal Court is a classic 2-bedroom apartment for sale in Upper Hill. Strategically situated on Mawesi Road, just off Elgon Road in the heart of Upper Hill, the property offers accessible, high-yield residential space ideal for corporate lets, medical professionals, and astute real estate investors.

It is positioned within walking distance of KNH, Nairobi Hospital, major corporate headquarters, and quick access routes to the Nairobi Expressway and CBD.

Features include functional living spaces, modern kitchen and service area, and comfortable bedrooms supported by good security, a backup generator for common areas and utility systems, and reliable municipal and auxiliary water storage.
